parameters.help_en: The name of the event bus
parameters.name: event_bus_name

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: The request was successful.

Other codes: The request failed. For information about error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。    

其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Data.description_en: The name of the event source

Action.description_en: The type of the event trace. Valid values: PutEvent, FilterEvent, and PushEvent. The value PutEvent indicates that the event was delivered. The value FilterEvent indicates that the event was filtered. The value PushEvent indicates that the event was pushed
Action.description_zh:
事件轨迹类型。取值说明如下：
PutEvent：投递事件。
FilterEvent：过滤事件。
PushEvent：推送事件

ActionTime.description_en: The execution time of the event trace

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the event target. This parameter is returned only if Action is set to PushEvent
Endpoint.description_zh: 事件目标的接入点。Action取值为PushEvent时的EventTrace属性

EventBusName.description_en: The name of the event bus

EventSource.description_en: The name of the event source

NotifyLatency.description_en: The delay period for which the event was delivered to the event target. This parameter is returned only if Action is set to PushEvent
NotifyLatency.description_zh: 事件目标投递延迟。Action取值为PushEvent时的EventTrace属性

NotifyTime.description_en: The time when the event was delivered to the event target. This parameter is returned only if Action is set to PushEvent
NotifyTime.description_zh: 事件目标投递时间。Action取值为PushEvent时的EventTrace属性

ReceivedTime.description_en: The time when the event was delivered to the event bus. This parameter is returned only if Action is set to PutEvent
ReceivedTime.description_zh: 事件投递到总线的时间。Action取值为PutEvent时的EventTrace属性

RuleMatchingTime.description_en: The time when the event rule was matched. This parameter is returned only if Action is set to FilterEvent
RuleMatchingTime.description_zh: 事件规则匹配通过时间。Action取值为FilterEvent时的EventTrace属性

RuleName.description_en: The name of the event rule

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true and false
